Evidence: updateChannel patches name with no duplicate check; PG has no unique index on (workspace_id, lower(name), category_id)
Reproduction: PATCH /api/channels/:id {name:'general'} on a second uncategorized channel -> two same-name channels in one workspace
Root cause: Rename path never grew the create-time guard; DB constraint absent
Impact: Duplicate-name channels; ambiguous lookups/UX; violates the docs Target Standard
Proposed fix: Add dup guard to updateChannel (workspace+category scoped, case-insensitive) + unique index migration after backfill
Required tests: rename-into-existing rejected; rename-to-same-name allowed; concurrent rename test
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): updateChannel rename guard scans local + PG (lower(name), workspace, category, archived-excluded, self-excluded); channel-local-mode.test.ts rename tests + channel-routes.test.ts PATCH 409

Evidence: PG dup check compares stored name to lowercased input eq(table.name, lower(name)) while rows store body.name verbatim; only the local scan lowercases both sides
Reproduction: Create 'General' (stored verbatim), then create 'general' with PG reachable: PG findFirst misses, local scan (PG-only row) also misses -> duplicate created
Root cause: Tier asymmetry: local check case-insensitive, PG check case-sensitive against lowercase input
Impact: Case-variant duplicates in dual mode (especially PG-only/legacy rows)
Proposed fix: Compare lower(name) on both sides (SQL lower) and/or store normalized name; add unique index
Required tests: case-variant duplicate rejected on both tiers; General vs general regression
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): PG dup check compares lower(name) on both sides (service create + db path); channel-dual-mode.test.ts asserts lower() SQL + lowered param, channel-local-mode.test.ts case-variant test

Evidence: Service-level local dup scan uses localListChannels (archived EXCLUDED, channel-local-store.ts:246) but localCreateChannel's internal scan reads raw rows (archived INCLUDED); PG check has no archived filter
Reproduction: Archive channel x; create x again in local mode: service guard passes, localCreateChannel returns {error:'duplicate_name'}
Root cause: Two different scans with different archive filters guard the same operation
Impact: Recreate-after-archive rejected with a misleading 400 (CHN-004); tier-dependent duplicate semantics
Proposed fix: Make archive handling explicit in one guard; decide archived rows block or not
Required tests: archived-then-recreate behavior pinned for both tiers
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): archived rows excluded from every dup scan (PG service create + PG db path + local create + local rename); tests: channel-local-mode.test.ts archive-then-recreate, channel-dual-mode.test.ts (PG SQL contains archived_at is null; dual recreate succeeds with single PG insert)

Evidence: Both {error:'category'} and {error:'duplicate_name'} map to 400 message 'Category not found: <categoryId>'; duplicate_name has no categoryId -> literal undefined
Reproduction: POST /api/channels with an existing name -> HTTP 400 'Category not found: undefined'
Root cause: Copy-pasted single error branch for a two-member union
Impact: Callers cannot distinguish duplicate from missing category over HTTP
Proposed fix: Branch on result.error and return distinct messages/codes
Required tests: route test asserting distinct 400 bodies for both union members

Evidence: Missing workspace scope returns {error:'category', categoryId:'(missing workspace scope)'}
Reproduction: POST /api/channels without x-workspace-id and without category -> 400 'Category not found: (missing workspace scope)'
Root cause: Tenant guard reuses the category-error union
Impact: Misleading operator signal for a tenant-scope failure
Proposed fix: Add {error:'workspace_required'} union member and route mapping

Evidence: Local category dup check reads outside the mutate lock; PG categories has no unique index
Reproduction: Two concurrent POST /api/categories with the same name -> both pass the dup read, both push
Root cause: Check-then-act without lock/constraint
Impact: Duplicate categories under concurrency
Proposed fix: Move dup check inside mutateJsonArray callback; add unique index (workspace_id, lower(name))
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): dup check runs INSIDE mutateJsonArray lock; channel-local-mode.test.ts concurrent category create leaves exactly one row (constraint migration CHN-025 still open)

Evidence: localCreateCategory throws on duplicate; the POST handler has no try/catch
Reproduction: POST /api/categories with an existing name (local mode) -> unhandled throw -> Fastify 500
Root cause: Union-vs-throw policy not applied to the category dup path
Impact: Users see 500 instead of a branchable 409/400
Proposed fix: Return a union (or catch at route) consistent with the domain error style
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): localCreateCategory returns {error:duplicate_name} union, route maps 409; channel-routes.test.ts duplicate category POST 409

Evidence: categoryExists is unscoped (searches all local workspaces); createChannel then writes the channel into the explicit ws
Reproduction: Create category in ws B; POST /api/channels with x-workspace-id A and categoryId of B -> channel created in A under B's category
Root cause: Parent-category existence checked without the caller's workspace scope
Impact: Cross-workspace parent reference; category/channel split across folders breaks mounts and sync
Proposed fix: Scope categoryExists to the resolved workspace and reject mismatch
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): categoryExists takes workspaceId and rejects cross-workspace parent refs (service create); channel-local-mode.test.ts cross-workspace create rejected

Evidence: updateChannelSettings wraps the PG upsert in pgCatchNull (all errors swallowed) then writes local; no outbox entry, no warn
Reproduction: Kill PG; PATCH settings -> 200 with local row; PG never converges and no outbox record exists
Root cause: Settings writes bypass dualWrite's outbox path
Impact: Permanent settings divergence between tiers; invisible failure
Proposed fix: Route settings through dualWrite or add outbox+warn on PG failure
Required tests: PG-down settings write test asserting outbox entry; convergence test
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): updateChannelSettings routes through dualWrite; PG failure queues a channelSettings outbox entry + warn; channel-dual-mode.test.ts PG-outage outbox test

Evidence: replayEntry switch handles category/channel/agent/message only; no channelSettings entity anywhere in workspace-sync
Reproduction: Fail PG during settings write (CHN-008), drain outbox, then push workspace: settings never reach PG
Root cause: Settings were never added to the outbox entity set
Impact: Pins/agent defaults lost on PG after any outage; multi-device divergence
Proposed fix: Add settings to outbox/replay + push/pull (or document local-only)
Required tests: outbox replay test for settings; sync round-trip test
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): OutboxEntity+replayEntry channelSettings case + push/pull legs in workspace-sync; channel-dual-mode.test.ts drain/push/pull tests

Evidence: settingsWorkspaceScope never throws: channel lookup failure/absence degrades to 'default'
Reproduction: Write a pin for a channel whose row is temporarily unreadable -> row lands in scope 'default'; later reads with the real scope miss it
Root cause: Best-effort scope resolution conflates unknown with the unscoped placeholder
Impact: Pins silently misfiled; cross-workspace pin bleed risk
Proposed fix: Distinguish unknown scope (reject/retry) from documented default; require explicit scope on writes
Status: Open — 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): warn-on-fallback landed + covered (channel-settings.test.ts CHN-010 warn test); reject/retry semantics for unknown scope still unimplemented

Evidence: getChannelSettings returns the LOCAL row when one exists even if dbOverride is provided (override does not pin PG, unlike every other op)
Reproduction: Seed a local pin and a different PG pin; call getChannelSettings(id, db) -> local value returned
Root cause: Settings read path predates the db-pins-PG convention
Impact: Test/seed/replay callers read the wrong tier; tier-dependent pin behavior
Proposed fix: Honor dbOverride (PG-first) or document the exception in the gate contract
Required tests: tier-selection test for settings with/without db override
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): getChannelSettings honors dbOverride PG-first, local fallback; channel-settings.test.ts CHN-011 tests (PG wins / local fallback)

Evidence: updateSettings has no channel-existence check; the test pins an orphan row (ch-orphan -> default scope)
Reproduction: PATCH /api/channels/no-such-channel/settings -> 200, orphan settings row
Root cause: Settings modeled as an independent upsert keyed by (channelId, workspaceId)
Impact: Orphan rows accumulate; a future channel reusing the id inherits stale pins (UUID ids make reuse unlikely)
Proposed fix: 404 on unknown channel or document orphans as intentional
Required tests: route test for unknown channel id
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): route refuses unknown-channel settings PATCH with 404 before any write (routes/channels.ts); channel-routes.test.ts 404 + no local orphan row. Gate stays permissive for fixture callers by design

Evidence: With dbOverride, createChannel skips the workspace guard and stores workspaceId ?? null; the dup check lacks the workspaceId filter
Reproduction: Call createChannel(body, db) without workspaceId -> row with workspaceId null (legacy global scope)
Root cause: dbOverride path is the pre-C3 code path kept verbatim
Impact: Legacy/global rows writable via tests/seeds; dup scope differs from the service path
Proposed fix: Thread workspaceId into the db path (or assert non-null) and scope the dup check
Required tests: db-path create tests for workspace scoping

Evidence: Non-db list fetches PG limit 200 and local limit 200, merges, then applies the cursor to the merged window only
Reproduction: Workspace with 250 PG channels: page 2 (cursor at row 200) returns no/partial rows because PG rows beyond the fetch window were never read
Root cause: Cursor applied after a bounded per-tier fetch
Impact: Lost rows past 200/tier in merged mode
Proposed fix: Fetch per-tier windows by keyset too (pass cursor into both legs) or raise/document the ceiling

Evidence: Nested channels in listCategories have no archived filter (local) and the PG nested query has no archivedAt where either; flat list excludes archived
Reproduction: Archive a channel; GET /api/categories still nests it; GET /api/channels does not return it
Root cause: Two listing shapes with different archive semantics
Impact: UI shows archived channels under categories while the flat list hides them
Proposed fix: Filter archived in both nested queries (or document nested=include-archived)

Evidence: updateChannel/deleteChannel take no workspaceId and never scope by workspace; routes do not pass one
Reproduction: Caller in ws A PATCHes/DELETEs a channel id owned by ws B (same DB) -> allowed if the row is visible in the pinned DB
Root cause: Workspace scoping was added to list/create/settings but not update/delete
Impact: Cross-workspace mutation wherever ids/dbs overlap (UUID ids limit practical risk)
Proposed fix: Thread workspaceId and reject mismatches, or resolve the row's workspace and compare

Evidence: fsMountsSchema accepts mode:'default' at channel/category level; only channel-mount-service.setEffectiveMounts refuses it - raw PATCH /api/channels/:id accepts and stores it
Reproduction: PATCH /api/channels/:id {fsMounts:{scope:'channel',mode:'default',mounts:[]}} -> stored; resolver ignores it (only override honored below workspace)
Root cause: Level/mode coherence enforced in one caller, not in the shared validator
Impact: Dead data persisted; UI may render a phantom mount set
Proposed fix: Refine validators per level or move the coherence rule into the service

Evidence: UpdateChannelBody has no folderPath, but updateChannel handles it and channel-mounts casts as any; REST PATCH strips unknown folderPath (zod default)
Reproduction: channelGate.update(id,{folderPath}) is a type error without a cast; REST folderPath via PATCH /api/channels/:id is silently dropped
Root cause: Schema grew a hidden field handled only via casts
Impact: Gate type does not describe the real contract; two folderPath write surfaces (mounts route vs channels route)
Proposed fix: Add folderPath to updateChannelSchema/body or document mounts-route-only ownership

Evidence: localRemoveCategory removes channel rows but not channel-settings.json rows nor messages/<channelId>.jsonl logs
Reproduction: Delete a category with a pinned channel (local mode) -> channel-settings.json still holds the dead channelId; message logs remain
Root cause: Local cascade mirrors only channels.json
Impact: Orphan settings/logs accumulate; a re-imported id could resurrect stale pins
Proposed fix: Cascade settings + optionally logs on local category delete (document message-retention choice)

Reproduction: lint allowlist entry 'routes/workspace.ts -> ../channels/channel-local-store.js'
Root cause: Seeding predates the gate; workaround never removed

Evidence: Shared owns push/pull/wipe/snapshot of categories.json/channels.json (reads LocalChannelRow/LocalCategoryRow types) and outbox replay for channel/category rows
Reproduction: grep shows file-row writes for channels/categories living outside the domain
Root cause: Shared is gate-exempt, so the facade rule does not see it

Proposed fix: Move sync's channel/category leg behind gate ports or document as an explicit Shared-owned bridge
Required tests: sync round-trip tests after any refactor

Evidence: ChannelIndex/CompressedSummary are exported through the gate but no reader/writer exists in the domain (channel_index is owned by index-builder/librarian-runtime)
Reproduction: grep: only schema/shared-core touch channel_index; the domain types are unused

Impact: Gate advertises contracts the domain does not honor

Evidence: user:message calls channelGate.getSettings(channelId) twice per message with no workspace scope -> each call re-reads the channel row to resolve scope
Reproduction: Send a message: two settings lookups, each with an extra channel read
Root cause: Scope resolution reads the channel row on every call; socket path never passes the scope it already has (msgChannel)
Impact: +1-2 indexed reads per message on the hot path; wrong-scope risk when the channel read fails (CHN-010)
Proposed fix: Pass msgChannel.workspaceId into getSettings; memoize scope per channel
Required tests: socket test asserting scope is threaded; perf smoke

Evidence: No unique index backs the duplicate-name rules for channels or categories; all dedupe is check-then-act
Reproduction: Concurrent or cross-path creates (CHN-001/002/006) can persist duplicates
Root cause: App-level guard without a DB-level constraint
Impact: Duplicates persist regardless of future code fixes until a constraint lands
Proposed fix: Add unique index migration on (workspace_id, lower(name), coalesce(category_id,'')) and (workspace_id, lower(name)) for categories; backfill duplicates first
Required tests: migration test; constraint violation mapped to duplicate_name

Evidence: No x-workspace-id -> list serves default-folder/all-workspace rows
Reproduction: GET /api/channels without the header on a multi-workspace local store

Evidence: get returns archived rows; list hides them

Reproduction: PATCH {name:'general-2'} then DELETE -> succeeds; the protected channel is destroyed
Root cause: Identity guard by name rather than an immutable marker
Impact: The never-destroyable guarantee is defeatable in two calls

Evidence: const existing = await localGetCategory(...) computed then unused in localUpdateCategory/localRemoveCategory
Reproduction: read: variable never referenced

Impact: Wasted read per update/delete

Evidence: PG failures on reads are silent (pgCatchNull), and the create dup-check Promise.all has .catch(() => [false,false]) which silently disables BOTH guards on any error
Reproduction: Kill PG mid-create: category+dup guards collapse to false and the create proceeds on the local tier
Root cause: Blanket catch converts infrastructure errors into guard-says-no-dup
Impact: Duplicate channels can be created during a PG outage with zero signal
Proposed fix: Log/flag swallowed errors; do not collapse guard errors to false

Evidence: localDeleteChannel removes only the channel row; channel-settings.json keeps the dead channelId (PG cascades via FK)
Reproduction: DELETE a pinned channel in local mode -> settings row remains
Root cause: Local delete mirrors only channels.json
Impact: Orphan settings rows accumulate locally
Proposed fix: Delete the settings row in localDeleteChannel

Evidence: updateChannelSettings attempts the PG write BEFORE the local write, inverting the local-first commit order; a local write failure leaves PG ahead with no compensation
Reproduction: Make the local settings write fail (disk error) after PG succeeds -> PG has the pin, local does not, caller sees the throw
Root cause: Settings path hand-rolls its own ordering instead of using dualWrite
Impact: Tier divergence on local failure; local-first contract violated
Proposed fix: Use dualWrite (local commit first, outbox on PG failure)
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): settings run through dualWrite — local commit first, PG replica second, outbox on failure; channel-dual-mode.test.ts order test + partial-patch merge test

Evidence: dualWrite runs pgWrite unconditionally after localWrite returns a guard-failure union; the local-only dup failure (archived-dup path, CHN-003) therefore still inserts into PG while the caller receives {error:'duplicate_name'}
Reproduction: Dual mode: archive channel x; recreate x -> service scan (excludes archived) passes; localCreateChannel returns {error}; pgWrite still inserts the channel into PG; API returns an error
Root cause: dualWrite never inspects the local result for business-failure unions
Impact: PG contains channels the API reported as rejected (phantom rows); local/PG divergence
Proposed fix: Have localCreateChannel signal guard failure before dualWrite (throw typed error or pre-check), or make dualWrite abort on union results
Required tests: dual-mode archived-recreate test asserting no PG row; local guard-failure test
Status: Fixed-verified 2026-10-07 (fix-channels): dualWrite inspects the localWrite union ({error}/{notFound}/{conflictGeneral}) and skips the PG leg + outbox; channel-dual-mode.test.ts guard-failure test (0 pgCalls, 0 outbox)
